field_errors.evidence: Fig. 2b caption: "Temperature dependence of the bulk and g.b. conductivity of Sc-NZSP (σbulk(298 K) = 2.0 mS cm−1)"

verdicts.explanation: Material, 2.0 mS/cm bulk value, experimental origin, 0.29 eV d.c. activation energy and sol-gel synthesis are all stated in the paper. The room-temperature value is given as 298 K in the Fig. 2b caption, so the null temperature in C is an omission.

field_errors.evidence: "At 20 °C the bulk conductivity of Na3Zr2(SiO4)2PO4 is 1.0 mS/cm, for σ′g.b. we found 0.7 mS/cm (Fig. 2b)."

verdicts.explanation: The 1.0 mS/cm bulk value for the Sc-free parent NZSP is correct and measured in this work. The paper states the temperature as 20 °C, so leaving the Celsius field null is an omission.

The paper states that at 20 °C the grain-boundary conductivity of Na3Zr2(SiO4)2PO4 is 0.7 mS/cm, with the grain-boundary response shown in Fig. 2b, and this is the authors' own measurement rather than a citation.
